page_title: BHA 3-1 BOU | Brighton v Bournemouth 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, John Brooks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

90+5' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle. Brighton have a free kick.
90+3' Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 4:4.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to David Brooks (Bournemouth).
88' Substitution. Simon Adingra makes way for Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
85' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' David Brooks (Bournemouth) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
83' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) replaces Lloyd Kelly.
82' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with David Brooks (Bournemouth) replacing Philip Billing.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ryan Christie will be replaced by Hamed Junior Traore (Bournemouth).
81' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

77' 3 - 1 Pervis Estupinan sends a superb cross into the box. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches on to it and from close range plants a header inside the right post, leaving Neto beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:1.
75' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Baleba (Brighton) replaces Mahmoud Dahoud.
72' The resulting corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

70' Bart Verbruggen makes a brilliant save! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
68' Joao Pedro (Brighton) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
66' Simon Adingra (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
64' That's the end of the game for Justin Kluivert, who is replaced by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
64' Here is a change. Marcus Tavernier is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Pedro (Brighton) comes onto the pitch for Danny Welbeck.
63' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
60' A cross into the box picks out Ansu Fati (Brighton), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the right post.
59' Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.
58' Adam Webster (Brighton) picks out Ansu Fati with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
57' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Neto makes a smart save to deny him.
54' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
51' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dominic Solanke, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
49' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Mahmoud Dahoud tees up Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Neto.
46' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Facundo Buonanotte is replaced by Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton).
46' It is time for a substitution. Ansu Fati (Brighton) is on for Evan Ferguson.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post.
45+3' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Billy Gilmour (Brighton) for his blatant foul.
45+2' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! An unlucky moment for Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but heads the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
45+2' The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
45+2' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Brighton win a corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
41' Yellow card. Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
40' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joel Veltman (Brighton) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' The ball is cleared after Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Neto makes a comfortable save.
32' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
31' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Dangerous play by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
25' 0 - 1 GOAL! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:1.
25' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) makes a strong challenge and John Brooks blows for a foul.
22' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
20' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' John Brooks blows for a foul after Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
19' A snap shot by Evan Ferguson (Brighton) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Neto produces a good save to thwart him.
16' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
14' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Brighton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Danny Welbeck (Brighton). The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.

7' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
5' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
4' John Brooks has a clear sight and sees a foul from Simon Adingra (Brighton).
2' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
John Brooks will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
